criterion: median rank <= 2 across all 171 predictions (inherited from section 4.3; reported as a fact, not a grade)
span_rule: token ids from index 50 onward; if the sequence has <= 51 tokens, start = min(1, n-1) (main pipeline fallback, activations.py::_mean_resid_post_single); ids include BOS
features: lowercased [a-z]+ word counts; vocabulary over all 205,200 spans; words in < 5 spans dropped; each span vector L2-normalized; empty spans excluded and counted
fitted_retrieval: WITHDRAWN before it was run by Amendment 1 (see amendment_1); never computed

i_all_words.zero_norm_handling: an emotion with a zero-norm centered vector in either half is excluded from both query and candidate sets

ii_exact_label_removed.zero_norm_handling: an emotion with a zero-norm centered vector in either half is excluded from both query and candidate sets

half_vectors: per emotion, mean over that emotion's set-A (set-B) non-empty spans, centered on the half's grand mean over 171 emotions
